units.source_text: 一个秋高气爽的午后，孙子广次抱着书包，慌忙从学校跑回家里。

en.t: On a crisp autumn afternoon, his grandson Hirotsugu clutched his schoolbag and hurried home from school.

units.source_text: 阿住当时正在仓库前利索的挥动菜刀，准备接着把蜂屋柿子吊起来晒干。

en.t: At that moment, Osumi was deftly handling a kitchen knife in front of the storehouse, getting ready to hang Hachiya persimmons to dry.

units.source_text: 广次动作灵敏的跳过一张晒着稻谷的席子，立正站好，向祖母阿住行礼。

en.t: Hirotsugu nimbly jumped over a mat where rice was drying, stood at attention, and bowed to his grandmother Osumi.

units.source_text: 接着严肃的直接问道：“奶奶，我妈妈真的是一个非常了不起的人吗？”

en.t: Then he asked her directly, with a serious look: "Grandma, is my mother really such an extraordinary person?"
